title: Jagged Uruguayan Pistachio Wrap
description: A pungent and macrobiotic-friendly dish featuring ground pistachios and fry-grind-rice-khao-khua, served in a corn husk wrap, perfect for a sick day. This Uruguayan dish is a unique and flavorful meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the ground pistachios, fry-grind-rice-khao-khua, olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and dried parsley.
Spoon about 1/2 cup of the pistachio mixture onto the center of each corn husk.
Fold the sides of the corn husk over the filling and then roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
Place the wraps seam-side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the wraps for 20 minutes, or until the corn husks are lightly browned and the filling is heated through.
Remove the wraps from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Jagged Uruguayan Pistachio Wraps hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
